title: ARCS Role Dossier Schema v1 (frozen)
description: Sensor (Perplexity) output contract for external opportunity reconnaissance. Feeds the honesty-graded resume-tailor Falsifier and the Loki/BAR adversarial gauntlet. Frozen after first dossier (Parloa FDE-US) surfaced two structural gaps; no further per-dossier field additions without a new convergence review.

core.description: Stable, always-answerable fields. All required - if unknown, use null with a claim entry explaining why, never omit the key.

extraction_risk.description: Structural hiring-process asymmetry signals. Distinct from vendor trust signals (data_privacy_signal) - these feed the ternary verdict directly rather than sitting as extension trivia. A positive finding on any leaf should pull the verdict toward TRAP or UNDECIDABLE, and must be traceable via evidence[].

evergreen_or_recycled_req.description: True if repost_pattern evidence suggests the req is continuously reposted without a genuine, resolvable headcount need.

bench_practice.description: Whether the company is known to interview/hire into a bench without a committed placement (common in staffing-adjacent or high-volume FDE-style hiring).

scope_matches_role.description: False if the take-home assignment resembles real production work disguised as an assessment.

extension.description: Best-effort fields. Every field nullable by design - absence means 'not found', not 'false'. Do not force a value to avoid a null; that reintroduces the false-negative trap.

data_privacy_signal.description: Nullable. Populate when the role's process names a specific interview-recording/screening vendor (BrightHire, Ribbon, Mercor, Read AI, HireVue, etc). Evidence-graded per vendor, not a single boolean - distinguish stated policy from technical guarantee from breach history.

label.description: Enum, never a numeric score. Loki/BAR must be able to re-derive this label independently from evidence[].

human_premortem_required.description: MUST be true whenever label == 'UNDECIDABLE'. May also be true for TRAP if stakes warrant. HITL sovereignty invariant.

rationale.description: One paragraph, plain language, citing evidence[] ids.

evidence.description: Raw claims backing core, extraction_risk, extension, and verdict. Every non-null field above must trace to at least one entry here.
